checks: Checked the four integer sites and the original two vertical halfspaces directly. Both miss the diagonal fibers and exactly one takes each off-diagonal whole unit fiber, so the residual minimum does not change between t=1 and t=2.
The absolute-value convex threshold agrees with all four sample roots, stays finite and nonnegative on the whole square, and attains the lower bound from the two diagonal terms.

For any affine L the opposite diagonal sums agree. L is at least 1 at each positive diagonal site, so the positive parts of the other two samples sum to at least 2. Jensen for q≥1 supplies the other 2, including q=1. The constant hinge is feasible.
Original 3869d933360d8c9c §3 (7)–(8) has the same fibers, fixed menu, list sizes and exponent range.

overlap.comparison: Includes the source's general one-cap residual contact program, but assumes a covering menu for the ranked-load theorem. Here the two original caps omit the diagonal, and the exact obstruction to restricting that program to one affine hinge is additional.
Optimizes a different positive-part functional for majorants of strictly positive volume roots. It does not compare single hinges on the sampled residuals with zeros.

readability: The threshold domination is imposed only at the sampled sites. A cap may be vertical in this example.

summary: The actual square support has residual roots (1,0,0,1) for either list size, and the sharp convex-versus-single-hinge optima are 2 and 4.
